answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 40286 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to ask that urine is which type of nijasat Question: I want to ask that urine is which type of nijasat? Nijasat ghaliza or khafeefa and how much of it amount is maaf if it stuck to clothes. How much amount of madhi is maaf if it stuck to clothes and it is which nijasah? Answer ID: 40286 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 645/602/N=1433) (1) The urine of man is nijasat ghalizah (major impurity). If it is smeared with the body or cloth and it spread equal to the area of one dirham (rupee) or less then it is forgiven, and if one offered salah without washing it his salah shall be valid but it is makrooh tahrimi to offer salah without washing it when it is equal to one rupee and makrooh tanzihi in case it is less than that. قال فى الدر (مع الرد كتاب الطهارة باب الأنجاس 1: 520-523 ط زكريا ديوبند): وعفا الشارع عن قدر درهم وإن كره تحريما فيجب عسله وما دونه تنزيها فيسن وفوقه مبطل ففرض ..... في رقيق من مغلظة كمعذرة آدمي وكذا كل ما خرج منه موجبا لوضوء أو غسل مغلظ اهـ (2) Madhi is also nijasat ghalizah and it carries the same ruling as mentioned above. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
